caseNameFull: Mrs. Ida Hughes v. The State of Georgia
attorneys: Messrs. Charles Clark and B. B. Jackson for plaintiff in error., No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

.Application for further proceedings in forma pauperis herein denied, for the reason that the court has examiried the typewritten record and found that the writ of error presents no substantial federal question.
